FAQ.title: How Can We Help You?
FAQ.subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions about our product. If you need additional help, feel free to contact us.

1.a: Follow the best traders in the market. When the trader buys, we buy; when the trader sells, we sell simultaneously. No manual operation required. Just connect your exchange API Key, configure the traders you want to follow on the CopyApes platform, and you can start fully automated copy trading in 5 minutes. If you connect a Lead Trader API Key, you can also run your copy trading strategy as a lead trader and earn additional profit-sharing income. You can use any exchange you prefer for copy trading.

2.q: How is CopyApes different from exchange's built-in copy trading?
2.a: Many exchanges now have built-in copy trading features, but you can only follow lead traders within that specific exchange. For example, you cannot follow an excellent OKX trader on Binance. On CopyApes, you can follow all excellent lead traders across the entire platform, including Binance, OKX, ByBit, and Bitget. You can even follow any trader on Bicoin and HyperLiquid. More importantly, you can combine multiple traders into a copy-trading portfolio to diversify risk and enhance returns.

3.q: Can I use my OKX account to follow a Binance lead trader?
3.a: Yes! Absolutely. We support major exchanges including Binance, OKX, ByBit, Bitget, Gate, HTX, and HyperLiquid, with more to come. You can deploy your copy trading strategy on any exchange. Some influential lead traders manage large amounts of funds on their native platforms, and their trades might cause significant slippage. At this time, following that lead trader and executing orders on another exchange might actually get you a better price than the lead trader themselves! However, please note that if the trading pair the lead trader is trading does not exist on your exchange, that order will not be executed.

4.q: What is the copy trading latency?
4.a: We use the industry's top copy trading technology to ensure extremely low latency. Most trades for private deployment users have a latency of a few hundred milliseconds, and during high throughput periods, the latency might be around 1 second. We also provide enterprise-grade WebSocket network technology for private deployment users, which can reduce latency to just a few milliseconds.

5.a: Of course! We are the only copy trading product in the industry that offers a long-term free trial. You can try it for free long-term under certain restrictions. You can resolve any issues encountered during use by yourself through our provided tutorial documents and videos.

6.a:
The safety of users' funds and trading security is always our top priority. We provide security protection from several dimensions:
1. Your funds stay in your own account. The API Key used by the platform only needs trading permissions; do not enable fund transfer permissions.
2. Ensure you fill in the IP whitelist when creating the API Key.
3. The platform uses bank-grade encryption algorithms to store API Key information securely.
4. In terms of trading security, the platform has designed multiple strategy stop-loss checks to ensure that strategy funds can stop losses in time when encountering extreme market conditions.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.intro: CopyApes ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our website and the CopyApes Assistant browser extension.

scope.title: 1. Scope
scope.body: This policy applies to the CopyApes website (copyapes.com), related API services, and the CopyApes Assistant Chrome extension. By using our website or extension, you acknowledge this policy.

collect.title: 2. Information We Collect
collect.body: We collect only information necessary to provide copy-trading services, including:
items: Account information: email, username, and other details you provide when registering.
Login credentials: your CopyApes login token to identify your account and maintain your session.
Exchange session data: cookies and related request headers read from authorized OKX/Binance pages when you initiate capture, for copy-trading cookie sync.
API information: exchange API keys you bind (we recommend trade-only permissions with IP whitelisting).
Extension local data: language, theme, cookie capture status, and panel visibility preferences stored locally in your browser.
Usage and log data: operation records and error logs to keep the service secure and reliable.

use.title: 3. How We Use Information
use.body: We use collected information only to:
items: Provide, maintain, and improve copy-trading features.
Sync exchange login state and perform cookie capture and copy tasks you initiate.
Verify identity and protect account and trading security.
Send service-related notices when necessary.
Comply with applicable laws and regulations.

extension.title: 4. Browser Extension Data Handling
extension.body: The CopyApes Assistant Chrome extension handles data as follows. The extension's collection and use of user data complies with the Chrome Web Store User Data Policy, including its Limited Use requirements:
items: Cookie and network request permissions (cookies, webRequest): reads cookies and request headers only when you visit exchange sites such as OKX and Binance, for cookie sync you initiate; we do not collect data on unrelated websites.
Local storage permission (storage): saves your login token, language, theme, and cookie capture status locally in your browser; this data is not uploaded unless you actively submit cookies.
Tab permissions (tabs, activeTab): used to identify the current exchange page and inject the operation panel with your authorization.
The extension does not collect or store your full browsing history, and is not used for advertising or user profiling.

share.title: 5. Sharing and Disclosure
share.body: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with advertisers, data brokers, or any unrelated third parties. We share necessary data only with the following parties:
items: CopyApes backend services (api.copyapes.com): receives account information, login tokens, exchange cookies, and API keys you actively submit, to provide copy-trading services.
Alibaba Cloud: as our cloud infrastructure provider, hosts our servers and databases; data is stored in Alibaba Cloud data centers located in Japan.
Exchanges (OKX, Binance, etc.): when you initiate copy-trading or cookie sync, we use your cookies or API keys to make requests to the corresponding exchange to execute authorized trading operations.
Other cases with your explicit consent.
When required by law or valid requests from authorities.
When necessary to protect the rights and safety of users, us, or the public.

storage.title: 6. Storage and Security
storage.body: Your data is stored on Alibaba Cloud servers located in Japan. We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including encrypted storage of sensitive credentials, access controls, and security audits.
items: API keys, exchange cookies, and other sensitive information are encrypted on our servers.
Extension preferences are stored locally on your device and can be cleared by uninstalling the extension.
While your account is active, we retain data necessary to provide our services.
After logout, your login token is immediately invalidated; after account deletion, we delete or anonymize your personal data within 30 days, unless otherwise required by law.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.body: You may access, correct, or delete your account information, withdraw consent, or stop using our services.
items: Manage API bindings and personal information in account settings.
Log out of the extension to clear local session data.
Request account and data deletion via the contact methods below.
Contact us through the website or by email if you need assistance.

contact.title: 8. Contact Us
contact.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact us:
items: Website: CopyApes Contact page (copyapes.com)
Email: service@copyapes.com
We will respond within 15 business days of receiving your request.

changes.title: 9. Policy Updates
changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised "Last updated" date. For material changes, we may notify you via website announcements. Continued use of our services means you accept the updated policy.

Footer.desc: Freely combine top lead traders from different exchanges, balance return and risk, create your exclusive copy trading strategy, and let the world's top traders work for you.

About.title: What is CopyApes
About.subtitle: A cross-exchange automated copy-trading assistant for crypto futures traders.
About.p1: CopyApes helps users automatically follow selected traders' open and close actions through official exchange APIs. Funds always stay in your own exchange accounts. The platform does not custody funds and does not take a profit-share seat fee from your copy trades.
About.p2: Unlike single-exchange built-in copy trading, CopyApes supports cross-platform following — for example, using an OKX account to follow a Binance lead trader, or combining multiple traders into one portfolio to diversify risk. The product is built for individual traders, lead-trader KOLs, and trading communities.
About.p3: Core capabilities include millisecond-to-second copy latency, multi-exchange support (Binance, OKX, Bybit, Bitget, Gate, HTX, HyperLiquid, and more), reverse copying, allow/deny lists, profit-condition copying, and private-domain Cookie/API workflows.
About.p4: We offer a long-term free trial tier, plus product docs, FAQs, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Service on the website. For partnerships or support, use Contact Us or email service@copyapes.com.

steps.title: Check the IP allowlist notice
steps.description: Trading APIs must add our IPs to the exchange allowlist. IPs can change; after long inactivity you may need to re-authorize.

steps.title: Add an API here

steps.title: Choose exchange
steps.description: Pick the exchange where you hold funds. Credentials differ by exchange; OKX, Bitget, and WEEX also need a Passphrase.

steps.title: Display name
steps.description: For your own labeling only, e.g. Main or Alt. You pick APIs by this name when creating tasks.

steps.title: Pick the right permission
steps.description: Read-only is for signals only and cannot place orders. Real copy trading requires Trade. Wrong choice means no fills.

steps.title: Enter API Key
steps.description: Create it on the exchange and paste it here. Do not enable withdrawal permissions.

steps.title: Secret and Passphrase
steps.description: Secret is shown only once when created—save it. For OKX, Bitget, and WEEX you also need Passphrase.

steps.title: IP allowlist is required
steps.description: Add every IP listed here to the API trust list on the exchange. Required for trade permissions; do not bind for read-only.

steps.title: Confirm binding
steps.description: We validate credentials before saving. Failures are usually wrong permissions or incomplete IP allowlist.

steps.title: Binding rules first
steps.description: One Cookie per exchange. To bind more for the same exchange, register additional CopyApes accounts.

steps.title: Recommended: browser extension
steps.description: Install the extension, log into CopyApes and the exchange, then auto-capture to sync here. Chrome installs directly; other browsers see the notes below.

steps.title: Fallback: manual upload
steps.description: If you cannot install the extension or need mobile remote updates, use Manual upload and paste a Cookie string or full cURL.

steps.title: Review bindings here
steps.description: Successful uploads appear under My exchange Cookies. Green means active; red means expired—recapture and update.

steps.title: Cookie required first
steps.description: When popular traders are full, we monitor and grab a seat. Bind an exchange Cookie first—grabbing needs a valid Cookie.

steps.title: Choose target exchange
steps.description: Pick OKX or Binance. The Cookie list below matches the selected exchange.

steps.title: Confirm Cookie is valid
steps.description: Status must show Valid. If missing or expired, rebind on the Cookie page.

steps.title: Enter trader and parse
steps.description: Paste the trader profile URL or ID, then Parse to extract the UID.

steps.title: Open amount settings
steps.description: Enabled only when exchange, valid Cookie, and trader are set. Use Config guide in the panel for amount fields.

grab-config-guide.title: Seat grab config guide
grab-config-guide.unavailableHint: Open the seat-grab config panel first, then start Config guide from the top-right.

steps.title: Verify target trader

steps.title: Set copy amount
steps.description: Capital used for copying after a seat is grabbed. Binance supports ratio or fixed size; OKX needs the copy amount.

steps.title: Start grabbing

steps.title: Paste profile URL or ID

steps.title: Pick the correct trader type

steps.title: Open copy settings

steps.title: Choose target exchange

withdraw.p1: On your exchange's API management page, <bold>only enable Read + Futures Trading</bold>. Never enable Withdraw or Transfer.
withdraw.p2: This is the foundational security safeguard. Without withdraw permission on the key, <bold>unauthorized fund transfers are physically and technically impossible</bold>.
withdraw.p3: Where to find API settings: Binance → profile (top right) → API Management; OKX → account settings (top left) → API; Bitget → profile (top left) → API Keys; Gate → profile (top left) → API; WEEX → Account Settings → API Management

encryption.title: API Secret stored with AES-256-CBC encryption
encryption.p1: Your API Secret / Passphrase is encrypted with <bold>AES-256-CBC symmetric encryption</bold> before being stored. Encryption keys are kept separately in GCP Secret Manager — never in code repos, logs, or backups.
encryption.p2: Even if the database were fully exported, attackers would only see ciphertext — <bold>the Secret cannot be recovered without the key</bold>. Platform staff, ops, and engineers <bold>cannot view your Secret in plain text</bold>.

engine.title: Copy engine only calls trading APIs — never touches principal
engine.p1: Our API-to-API copy engine only calls: <bold>place order / cancel order / query positions / query balance / set leverage</bold>.
engine.p2: It <bold>will never call</bold> withdraw, transfer, API Key management, or other fund-related APIs.
engine.p3: Strict permission isolation ensures only trade instructions are executed. The system cannot bypass exchange permission controls — withdraw and transfer APIs are never invoked.

control.title: You have full control — revoke anytime
control.p1: You can delete this API Key on the <bold>exchange</bold> at any time (no action needed on our platform). Once deleted, copy trading stops immediately and all active copy tasks halt.
control.p2: You can also edit the label on this page, or delete the API account here to unbind instantly.

contractRisk.title: Understand futures trading risks
contractRisk.p1: Futures trading is a <bold>high-risk derivative product</bold> with the following risks:

bullets.liquidation: <bold>Liquidation risk</bold>: volatile markets may wipe out all margin
bullets.latency: <bold>Latency risk</bold>: copy flow goes signal monitoring → system processing → exchange order — seconds of delay are possible
bullets.strategy: <bold>Strategy risk</bold>: past trader performance does not guarantee future results
bullets.system: <bold>System risk</bold>: network or exchange outages may cause missed signals
bullets.human: <bold>Human risk</bold>: traders may misjudge, trade emotionally, or hold losing positions

contractRisk.p2: <bold>All profits and losses are your responsibility.</bold>

allocation.title: Keep copy allocation under 50% of account
allocation.p1: Copy trading uses margin in your account. Volatile markets or trader anomalies may tie up excessive margin. Recommendations:

bullets.first: <bold>First copy</bold>: allocate only 10%–20% of account funds; observe for 1 week
bullets.stable: <bold>After stability</bold>: gradually increase to within 50% of account
bullets.reserve: <bold>Keep buffer</bold>: always maintain 50%+ free margin to avoid liquidation

privacy.title: Data privacy
privacy.p1: We <bold>will not</bold> sell or share your API Key, positions, or P&L data with any third party. Data is used only for copy execution, risk control, and P&L statistics.
privacy.p2: Your copy trading data on this platform is <bold>visible only to you</bold>. Platform staff will not access your personal data without your authorization.
